sections.heading: Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Programs and Therapies

blocks.text: Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre offers comprehensive treatment programs for substance use disorder, eating disorders, sex addiction, and co-occurring mental health conditions. To ensure that clients receive the right level of care, Sandstone provides a range of programs that include medical detox, intensive outpatient programs (IOPs), virtual IOPs, and residential treatment. The facility’s program combines evidence-based therapies, including cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) and dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), relapse prevention, meditation, yoga, and other holistic approaches. Clients receive one-on-one attention from caring and compassionate clinicians, ensuring that their individual needs are met.

sections.heading: Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Daily Routine

blocks.text: Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre provides a structured daily routine that is designed to help clients develop healthy habits and promote healing. The day begins with a healthy and delicious chef-prepared breakfast, followed by time to meditate. Clients will engage in a physical fitness routine that can include gym time, walking, or attending a yoga class. After the morning exercise, clients attend a psychoeducational lecture to learn about the nature of their substance use. In the afternoon, clients will have individual counseling followed by a delicious dinner. After dinner, clients will attend a group AA, NA, or SMART panel before enjoying game night or TV time. The structured routine provides predictability and stability, helping clients focus on their recovery.

sections.heading: Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Rich History and Location

blocks.text: Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre has a rich history dating back to 1967. The facility has undergone significant renovations and has been beautifully restored to offer clients a comfortable and home-like environment. The facility is located in a quiet neighborhood in Calgary, Canada, providing a serene and peaceful setting for healing. The intimate setting offers those struggling with addiction and related mental health concerns a safe space for recovery. The attentive staff ensures that clients receive the highest level of care and support they need during their stay.

sections.heading: Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Admissions Process and Cost

blocks.text: The admissions process for Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre is straightforward. Clients can either self-refer or be referred by a healthcare provider. Sandstone offers an extensive assessment to determine the client’s treatment needs and recommendations for care. The facility accepts a range of insurance options, and there is also private pay and financing available for those who need assistance. The cost of the program varies depending on the level of care, but a financial representative is available to help clients understand their options and create a plan that works for them.

sections.heading: Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre - Center Overview

blocks.text: The Sandstone Impatient Treatment Centre is an inclusive and caring environment providing personalized treatment programs and a tailored approach for each patient’s needs. We offer both inpatient and outpatient programs and have a mission of making addiction recovery accessible to all. Our intensive outpatient treatment program is perfect for individuals who require consistent and structured assistance in their recovery, but still maintain responsibilities outside of treatment. The inpatient program, however, is a comprehensive program for individuals who require complete support in a distraction-free environment to facilitate their rehabilitation.

centre.about_html:
Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Programs and Therapies

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre offers comprehensive treatment programs for substance use disorder, eating disorders, sex addiction, and co-occurring mental health conditions. To ensure that clients receive the right level of care, Sandstone provides a range of programs that include medical detox, intensive outpatient programs (IOPs), virtual IOPs, and residential treatment. The facility’s program combines evidence-based therapies, including cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) and dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), relapse prevention, meditation, yoga, and other holistic approaches. Clients receive one-on-one attention from caring and compassionate clinicians, ensuring that their individual needs are met.

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Daily Routine

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre provides a structured daily routine that is designed to help clients develop healthy habits and promote healing. The day begins with a healthy and delicious chef-prepared breakfast, followed by time to meditate. Clients will engage in a physical fitness routine that can include gym time, walking, or attending a yoga class. After the morning exercise, clients attend a psychoeducational lecture to learn about the nature of their substance use. In the afternoon, clients will have individual counseling followed by a delicious dinner. After dinner, clients will attend a group AA, NA, or SMART panel before enjoying game night or TV time. The structured routine provides predictability and stability, helping clients focus on their recovery.

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Rich History and Location

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre has a rich history dating back to 1967. The facility has undergone significant renovations and has been beautifully restored to offer clients a comfortable and home-like environment. The facility is located in a quiet neighborhood in Calgary, Canada, providing a serene and peaceful setting for healing. The intimate setting offers those struggling with addiction and related mental health concerns a safe space for recovery. The attentive staff ensures that clients receive the highest level of care and support they need during their stay.

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Admissions Process and Cost

The admissions process for Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre is straightforward. Clients can either self-refer or be referred by a healthcare provider. Sandstone offers an extensive assessment to determine the client’s treatment needs and recommendations for care. The facility accepts a range of insurance options, and there is also private pay and financing available for those who need assistance. The cost of the program varies depending on the level of care, but a financial representative is available to help clients understand their options and create a plan that works for them.



Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre - Center Overview

The Sandstone Impatient Treatment Centre is an inclusive and caring environment providing personalized treatment programs and a tailored approach for each patient’s needs. We offer both inpatient and outpatient programs and have a mission of making addiction recovery accessible to all. Our intensive outpatient treatment program is perfect for individuals who require consistent and structured assistance in their recovery, but still maintain responsibilities outside of treatment. The inpatient program, however, is a comprehensive program for individuals who require complete support in a distraction-free environment to facilitate their rehabilitation.

At Sandstone, our programs are designed to incorporate evidence-based treatment practices that are effective in promoting healing and recovery. Additionally, our intimate and welcoming setting, combined with our knowledgeable and compassionate medical professionals, offers a serene and calming atmosphere that supports our patients’ journey to a successful recovery. Our programs have been successful in helping many individuals struggling with addiction and we continuously strive to provide the most compassionate, tailored care possible.

Frequently Asked Questions About Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre

What substance use disorders do you treat?

We treat a range of substance use disorders, including alcohol addiction, opiate addiction, and cocaine addiction.

Do you offer virtual services?

Yes, we offer virtual intensive outpatient programs (IOPs) for clients who cannot attend in-person.

What is the staff-to-client ratio?

We maintain a low staff-to-client ratio to ensure that clients receive individual attention and personalized care.

Is the treatment confidential?

Yes, we respect our clients’ privacy, and all information shared during treatment remains confidential.

Is there an age requirement for treatment?

We treat clients who are 18 years and older.

How long does the program last?

The program length varies depending on the client’s treatment needs. Our programs range from 30 to 90 days.

Can family members visit?

Yes, we do allow family visits, and we also offer family therapy sessions.

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Programs and Therapies

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre offers comprehensive treatment programs for substance use disorder, eating disorders, sex addiction, and co-occurring mental health conditions. To ensure that clients receive the right level of care, Sandstone provides a range of programs that include medical detox, intensive outpatient programs (IOPs), virtual IOPs, and residential treatment. The facility’s program combines evidence-based therapies, including cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) and dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), relapse prevention, meditation, yoga, and other holistic approaches. Clients receive one-on-one attention from caring and compassionate clinicians, ensuring that their individual needs are met.

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Daily Routine

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre provides a structured daily routine that is designed to help clients develop healthy habits and promote healing. The day begins with a healthy and delicious chef-prepared breakfast, followed by time to meditate. Clients will engage in a physical fitness routine that can include gym time, walking, or attending a yoga class. After the morning exercise, clients attend a psychoeducational lecture to learn about the nature of their substance use. In the afternoon, clients will have individual counseling followed by a delicious dinner. After dinner, clients will attend a group AA, NA, or SMART panel before enjoying game night or TV time. The structured routine provides predictability and stability, helping clients focus on their recovery.

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Rich History and Location

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre has a rich history dating back to 1967. The facility has undergone significant renovations and has been beautifully restored to offer clients a comfortable and home-like environment. The facility is located in a quiet neighborhood in Calgary, Canada, providing a serene and peaceful setting for healing. The intimate setting offers those struggling with addiction and related mental health concerns a safe space for recovery. The attentive staff ensures that clients receive the highest level of care and support they need during their stay.

Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre’s Admissions Process and Cost

The admissions process for Sandstone Inpatient Treatment Centre is straightforward. Clients can either self-refer or be referred by a healthcare provider. Sandstone offers an extensive assessment to determine the client’s treatment needs and recommendations for care. The facility accepts a range of insurance options, and there is also private pay and financing available for those who need assistance. The cost of the program varies depending on the level of care, but a financial representative is available to help clients understand their options and create a plan that works for them.
